newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH SHELL CUTS GASOLINE AND DIESEL PRICES.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH SHELL CUTS GASOLINE AND DIESEL PRICES.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell unit Shell Nederland BV said on Thursday it will cut its retail prices for gasolines and diesel in the Netherlands by 2.0 cents per litre with effect from December 14.
The move reflects changes in international product prices and the value of the dollar against the guilder, the company said.
From Saturday the price of premium unleaded gasoline at Shell's self-service stations falls to 2.08 guilders per litre.
The price of premium with lead substitute falls to 2.15 guilders and that of Euro regular unleaded to 2.03 guilders.
The recommended price for diesel goes down to 1.480 guilders per litre, Shell said.
